title: Français 3758 — Louis XIII, 30 juin 1635
contents: Royal campaign instructions, the use of time and forces, cooperation with the Prince of Orange, and the need to cipher important dispatches.
status: 10/10 pages transcribed; 6/6 cipher pages deciphered in part
fields: 53 mapped signs: 40 letter signs, 13 in nomenclature.
Plaintext in another folio of the same volume

Actual historical plaintext copies appear in blank/facing-page areas: PDF128 right lower and PDF129 left for f115r; PDF131 left (f116v) copies selected f117r passages, including the Orange/route instructions and the warning about an intercepted dispatch.

excerpt: Quand vous m’escriprez quelque chose d’importance souvenez vous que ce soit en chiffre. **Car sy la despesche** du xviiᵉ **fust tombée entre les mains des Ennemis, ilz eussent appris [?] et en eussent tiré ?duantage**.
translation: When you write something important to me, remember to put it in cipher. For if the dispatch of the seventeenth had fallen into the enemies’ hands, they would have learned [?] and gained an [?] advantage from it.
